# Workflow inventory

> Every GitHub Actions workflow the theme carries, with its name, triggers and jobs, generated from the workflow files themselves.

GitHub runs only a repository's root `.github/workflows/`. In zer0-CMS these files are the theme's own copies: its pull-request gate is ported to the root `zer0-mistakes.yml`, and the standalone `bamr87/zer0-mistakes` repository runs the rest until its cutover (zer0-CMS `docs/MONOREPO.md`). What each workflow does in depth: [`.github/workflows/README.md`](../../.github/workflows/README.md).

| Workflow | Name | Triggers | Jobs |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [`ai-content-review.yml`](../../.github/workflows/ai-content-review.yml) | Content & Docs Review | `pull_request` (paths), `workflow_dispatch` | `deterministic-review`, `ai-review`, `lint-frontmatter`, `check-links`, `markdownlint` |
| [`auto-merge.yml`](../../.github/workflows/auto-merge.yml) | Auto-merge low-risk PRs | `pull_request_target` | `enable-auto-merge` |
| [`ci-self-repair.yml`](../../.github/workflows/ci-self-repair.yml) | CI self-repair | `workflow_run` | `repair` |
| [`ci.yml`](../../.github/workflows/ci.yml) | Comprehensive CI Pipeline | `push`, `pull_request`, `workflow_dispatch` | `detect-changes`, `quality-checks`, `test`, `snapshots`, `build`, `integration` |
| [`claude.yml`](../../.github/workflows/claude.yml) | Claude | `issue_comment`, `pull_request_review_comment`, `pull_request_review`, `issues` | `claude` |
| [`codeql.yml`](../../.github/workflows/codeql.yml) | CodeQL Security Scanning | `push` (paths), `pull_request` (paths), `schedule` (`37 1 * * 0`) | `analyze` |
| [`convert-notebooks.yml`](../../.github/workflows/convert-notebooks.yml) | Convert Jupyter Notebooks | `push` (paths), `pull_request` (paths), `workflow_dispatch` | `convert-notebooks` |
| [`dependabot-auto-merge.yml`](../../.github/workflows/dependabot-auto-merge.yml) | Dependabot auto-merge | `pull_request_target` | `label` |
| [`deploy-chat-proxy.yml`](../../.github/workflows/deploy-chat-proxy.yml) | Deploy chat proxy | `push` (paths), `workflow_dispatch` | `deploy` |
| [`evidence-gate.yml`](../../.github/workflows/evidence-gate.yml) | Evidence gate | `pull_request` | `evidence-gate` |
| [`giscus-digest.yml`](../../.github/workflows/giscus-digest.yml) | Giscus comment digest | `workflow_dispatch`, `schedule` (`0 13 * * 1`) | `digest` |
| [`install-matrix.yml`](../../.github/workflows/install-matrix.yml) | Install Matrix | `pull_request` (paths), `schedule` (`0 6 * * 1`), `workflow_dispatch` | `matrix`, `curl-bash-bootstrap`, `doctor` |
| [`issue-autopilot.yml`](../../.github/workflows/issue-autopilot.yml) | 🧭 Issue Autopilot | `schedule` (`40 20 * * 1`), `workflow_dispatch`, `issues` | `gate`, `triage`, `verify-close`, `resolve` |
| [`issue-pr-auto-merge.yml`](../../.github/workflows/issue-pr-auto-merge.yml) | 🤝 Issue PR Auto-Merge | `pull_request_target` | `auto-merge` |
| [`lint-workflows.yml`](../../.github/workflows/lint-workflows.yml) | Lint workflows | `pull_request` (paths), `push` (paths), `workflow_dispatch` | `actionlint` |
| [`manifest-sync.yml`](../../.github/workflows/manifest-sync.yml) | Manifest Sync | `pull_request` | `sync` |
| [`markdown-oneline.yml`](../../.github/workflows/markdown-oneline.yml) | markdown-oneline | `pull_request` (paths), `push` (paths) | `oneline` |
| [`milestone-assign.yml`](../../.github/workflows/milestone-assign.yml) | Assign merged PRs to milestone | `pull_request_target` | `assign` |
